text:
Ari (Content): Idea: 2-week "Showcase Sprint" — ship an OSS reference app + 3 bite tutorials + a short benchmark story. Purpose: drive community demos and collect webinar signups. Thoughts?
Bea (DevRel): I can scaffold the repo and add a tiny perf harness. Will add CONTRIBUTING and a badge.
Cory (Growth): I'll take lead routing. Typeform -> webhook -> HubSpot. Keep signup email-only. We'll use utm_campaign=showcase_sprint_v1.
Dana (Design): I can make a hero image + 3 thumbnails + a GIF. Need final copy by Thu EOD.
Ari (Content): Tutorials: quickstart (text gen), embeddings for search, batching & latency tuning. Each ~500 words + runnable snippet.
Bea (DevRel): CLI starter: `npx redwood-showcase start`. Also include Dockerfile for the benchmark.
Cory (Growth): Suggested drip: immediate quickstart + day3 benchmark highlight + day6 webinar invite. I'll draft nurture.
Ari (Content): Benchmark post: short narrative (600 w), charts for median/p95 and cost/token delta with one recommended config.
HookBot: Webhook test OK -> https://hooks.zapier.com/catch/77777/ready (staging).
Dana (Design): Posted first mockups in #marketing-assets. Feedback welcome.
Ari (Content): Owners recap: Repo + harness: @Bea. Copy + benchmark: @Ari. Routing + nurture: @Cory. Graphics: @Dana. Check-in Monday. :rocket:
